config.name: vector
config.method: dense cosine similarity over pgvector HNSW (m=16, ef_construction=64)

latency.scope: retriever.retrieve() wall time incl. query embedding; 3 warm-up queries excluded

limitations: 80 hand-verified queries over one 227-page corpus: differences of a few points between configs are within noise for a set this size.
Relevance labels are binary and document-level; they were audited against dense and full-text pools, so pages neither system retrieved may be unlabeled.
Generation scores come from an LLM judge, not human raters.
Latency was measured on one developer machine with a local PostgreSQL in Docker; it includes CPU query embedding.
